name: DD-1 hover droid
description: The DD-1 hover droid was a type of training droid, sometimes customized and utilized by the Jedi Order to teach Jedi Initiates on Tenoo. Younglings training at the Tenoo Jedi Temple dueled against these fast-moving droids to hone their acrobatics and fighting skills against the droids' quadruple electroblade training swords.
